records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero engagement: no project, no invite, no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:5f810d38]. Only one-way Wrenfield contact exists, so there is no signal of intent or a planned next step. Pro plan and 8 days remaining leave some chance of self-serve activation, but silent accounts rarely convert unaided.

draft.subject: Getting your first project started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Following up on my welcome note — it looks like things haven't quite gotten moving yet, which is easy to do in a first week.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating the first project is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything about setting your team up.

Best,
Nadia
